Sun.Essence: Soul (Atman), Spirit, King, Vitality, Center of Existence.
Sun.Nature: Hot, dry, masculine, positive, fiery (Satwa guna/Bilious temperament).
Sun.Domains: Self-reliance, magnetism, willpower, political power, nobility, courage, psychic development, godliness.
Sun.Career: Kings, Government, those in power, paternal lineage, authority figures.
Sun.Body_Parts: Heart (primary), Head, Brain, Right eye (males), Bones, Mouth, Spleen, Throat, Lungs, Blood circulation.
Sun.Psychology_Positive: Boldness, commanding ability, fame, dignity, vitality, royal appearance, optimism, respect for elders.
Sun.Psychology_Afflicted: Arrogance, meanness, boastfulness, irritability, jealousy, pride, immorality, domineering nature.
Sun.Health: Heart problems, epilepsy, cerebral disorders, meningitis, fevers, eye diseases, low blood pressure, sunstroke.
Sun.Products: Rice, Wheat, Gold, Copper, Ruby, Chillies, Spices (Saffron, Asafoetida), Lion, Boar, Horse.
Sun.Locations: Mountains, forests, Shiva temples, government buildings, public offices.
Sun.Fundamental: Resistance and vitality, determination and decisiveness, giver of life force/spirit.

Moon.Nature: Cold, moist, feminine, changeable, watery (Satwa guna/Phlegmatic temperament).
Moon.Rulership: North-West, Monday, Silvery white/Sea-green, Varsha Ritu (August-September).
Moon.Domains: Mind, sleep, consciousness, mother, maternal relationships, personality, feelings, travel, commerce.
Moon.Career: multitude, the masses, female relatives, home life, place of residence.
Moon.Body_Parts: Left eye (males), Right eye (females), Breasts, Esophagus, Stomach, Uterus, Ovaries, Bladder, Synovial fluid.
Moon.Psychology_Positive: High position in public life, amiability, charm, magnetism, proper thinking, good judgment, fair means of earning.
Moon.Psychology_Afflicted: Unfortunate, impulsive, over-anxious, indecisive, rash, depressed, pessimistic.
Moon.Health: Lunacy, eye diseases, paralysis, hysteria, epilepsy, cough/cold, asthma, cancer, typhoid, dysentery.
Moon.Products: Oranges, Melon, Cucumber, Rice, Milk products (Cream, Curd), Silver, Pearl, Mercury (metal).
Moon.Locations: Mountains, fortresses, Ocean, rivers, water bodies, place of residence.
Moon.Fundamental: Changeable and elastic qualities, governs life on earth, mind, maternal instincts, and cyclical nature.

Mars.Nature: Dry, fiery, masculine, malefic (Tamas guna/Bilious, hot temperament).
Mars.Domains: Brothers, sisters, Body_Parts strength, mental power, fighting power, logical reasoning, enterprise, lands.
Mars.Career: Military, heir-apparents, weapons, contentions, engineering, industrial work.
Mars.Body_Parts: Forehead, Left ear, Nose, Muscular system, External sex organs, Kidneys, Prostate, Red bone marrow.
Mars.Psychology_Positive: Adventurous, independent, generous, ambitious, enthusiastic, pioneer, leader, hero, warrior.
Mars.Psychology_Afflicted: Rash, aggressive, combative, destructive, headstrong, quarrelsome, extremist behavior.
Mars.Health: Fevers, inflammatory complaints, smallpox, burns, accidents, surgeries, hemorrhages, hernia, appendicitis.
Mars.Products: Groundnut, Walnut, Ginger, Mustard, Garlic, Brandy, Whisky, Copper, Iron, Steel, Coral, Ruby.
Mars.Locations: Battlefield, smith's shops, police station, industrial area, jungles, mountains, chemical labs.
Mars.Fundamental: Senses and animal instincts, constructive and destructive energy, Warrior spirit, intensity and passion.

Mercury.Nature: Variable, convertible, feminine, neutral, dualistic (Rajasa guna/Mixed temperament).
Mercury.Domains: Mind, memory, intellect, education, commerce, speech, writing, central nervous system, reproductive ability.
Mercury.Career: Paternal Uncle, literary pursuits, bookselling, hygiene, paper money, banks.
Mercury.Body_Parts: Nose, Brain, Hands, Tongue, Lungs, Nervous system, Skin.
Mercury.Psychology_Positive: Quick grasp, retentive memory, oratory, business ability, intuitive, works with speed and accuracy.
Mercury.Psychology_Afflicted: Cunning, mischievous, anonymous petition writer, gambler, liar, inconsistent, boastful, stammering.
Mercury.Health: Insanity, loss of speech, impotency, deafness, headaches, neuralgia, insomnia, vertigo, convulsions.
Mercury.Products: Betel leaves, Walnut, Spinach, Ghee, Bell's metal, Emerald, Quick silver (Mercury metal).
Mercury.Locations: Universities, colleges, schools, commercial centers, fields for sports, hunting places.
Mercury.Fundamental: Rules intelligence and exchange of ideas, the communicative bridge between thought and expression.

Jupiter.Essence: Deva Guru (Teacher of Gods), Expansion, Wisdom, Money.
Jupiter.Nature: Fiery, noble, benevolent, fruitful, masculine, jovial (Sattvaguna/Optimistic temperament).
Jupiter.Domains: Finance, wealth, children (progeny), education, happiness, morals, reputation, charity, philosophy.
Jupiter.Career: Teachers, religious institutions, courts, legislatures, banks, financial institutions.
Jupiter.Body_Parts: Liver (primary), Fat, Blood circulation in arteries, Tumors, Pleura of lungs, Kidney, Thigh, Feet, Right ear.
Jupiter.Psychology_Positive: Jovial, hopeful, broad-minded, prudent, progress, rapid recovery, fair means, worldly wisdom.
Jupiter.Psychology_Afflicted: Extremist, extravagant, over-optimistic, gambler, misjudgment, miscalculation.
Jupiter.Health: Blood poisoning, liver complaints, flatulence, hernia, diabetes, eczema, vertigo, abscesses.
Jupiter.Products: Ghee, Butter, Oranges, Banana, Big trees (Peepal), Oak, Rubber, Gold, Platinum, Yellow Sapphire, Topaz.
Jupiter.Locations: Courts, pompous buildings, temples, colleges, schools, legislative assemblies, banks.
Jupiter.Fundamental: Expansion in all forms, giver of fortune and grace, moral integrity, accumulation of spiritual wealth.

Venus.Essence: Asura Guru (Teacher of Demons), Love, Beauty, Comfort, Desire.
Venus.Nature: Feminine, warm, temperate, fruitful (Rajasa guna/Sensual, artistic temperament).
Venus.Rulership: South-East, Friday, White/Dark Blue/Lemon Yellow, Vasanta Ritu (April-May).
Venus.Domains: Wife (males), marriage, sexual pleasure, beauty, luxury, fine arts, music, drama, vehicles.
Venus.Career: Partners in business, fine arts professionals, fashion, cosmetics, amusements.
Venus.Body_Parts: vision, reproductive system, throat, chin, cheeks, kidneys, hair.
Venus.Psychology_Positive: Artistic, appreciative of harmony, romantic, diplomatic, charming, continuous good luck.
Venus.Psychology_Afflicted: Deprived sexual tendencies, immoral character, sex scandals, loss of prestige, excessive drinking.
Venus.Health: Venereal diseases, eye infections, skin diseases (eczema, leprosy), enlarged tonsils, renal issues, goiter.
Venus.Products: Textiles, Silk, Perfumery, Sandalwood oil, Diamond, Beryl, Pearls, Platinum, Silver.
Venus.Locations: Bedroom, cinema, garden, banquet hall, mines, automobile industries, shipping yards.
Venus.Fundamental: Principle of attraction and harmony, rules over desires, romance, and artistic expression.

Saturn.Essence: Yama (God of Time), Karma, Discipline, Longevity, Delay.
Saturn.Nature: Barren, binding, cold, constant, dry, defensive, hard (Tamas guna/Melancholic temperament).
Saturn.Rulership: West, Saturday, Blue/Jet Black, Shishir Ritu (February-March).
Saturn.Domains: Longevity, hard work, discipline, delays, obstacles, old age, poverty, karma, endurance, patience.
Saturn.Career: Old people, servants, labor, mining, wood/steel industries, tanning factories.
Saturn.Body_Parts: Teeth, Bones, Right ear, Knees, Spinal cord, Hair, Obstruction of fluids/waste.
Saturn.Psychology_Positive: Economy, thrift, perseverance, self-control, sense of duty, sincerity, prudence, sincerity.
Saturn.Psychology_Afflicted: Persistent bad luck, sorrows, dejection, lazy, lethargic, vindictive, distrustful.
Saturn.Health: Cancer, paralysis, sciatica, tooth decay, asthma, spine curvature, gout, fracture, rheumatism.
Saturn.Products: Kerosene, Petrol, Coal, Iron, Lead, Leather, Potato, Barley, Black pulses, Blue Sapphire, Amethyst.
Saturn.Locations: Hills, forests, deserts, caves, old/ruined buildings, churches, trenches, stinking/dirty places.
Saturn.Fundamental: The Great Teacher through hardship, taskmaster of the zodiac, governs time and karma.

Rahu.Essence: Dragon's Head, Future, Obsession, Innovation, Shadow.
Rahu.Rulership: South-West, Smoke color, Diplomatic/Illusionist (Similar properties to Saturn).
Rahu.Domains: Gains, mundane prosperity, material advancement, foreign elements, unconventional paths, innovation.
Rahu.Career: Foreigners, outcasts, thieves, spies, psychologists, inventors, aviators.
Rahu.Body_Parts: Buttocks, Intestinal tract, distinctive personality (when in ascendant).
Rahu.Psychology_Positive: Ambitious, development of new skills/territories, breaking traditional boundaries, worldly gains.
Rahu.Psychology_Afflicted: Dissatisfied, telling lies, harsh speech, unnatural activities, diplomat, cunning, creates illusions.
Rahu.Health: Hiccups, insanity, intestinal problems, ulcers, fevers, sudden accidents, poisoning.
Rahu.Products: Meat, Wine, Radish, Coconut, Radio, Aeroplanes, Modern machinery, Explosives, Agate, Lapis Lazuli.
Rahu.Locations: Ant-hills, cracked ground, underground passages, airports, radio stations, laboratories.
Rahu.Fundamental: Points toward future karmic destiny, creates maya (illusion) and catalysts for evolution.

Ketu.Essence: Dragon's Tail, Past, Detachment, Moksha, Intuition.
Ketu.Rulership: Variegated color, Seer/Spiritual force (Similar properties to Mars).
Ketu.Domains: Losses (material), Moksha (salvation), spiritual liberation, past life karma, natural talents, renunciation.
Ketu.Career: Mendicants, ascetics, philosophers, occultists, religious resigned individuals.
Ketu.Body_Parts: Buttocks, Intestinal tract, unusual/spiritual personality (when in ascendant).
Ketu.Psychology_Positive: Seer, intuitive, spiritual seeker, detached, natural skills from previous births.
Ketu.Psychology_Afflicted: Miserliness, quarrels, deception, backbiting, vicious tendencies, secretive intrigues.
Ketu.Health: Insanity, mysterious ailments, psychosomatic disorders, biliousness, intestinal problems.
Ketu.Products: Charms, Amulets, Skulls, Religious artifacts, Turquoise, Cat's eye.
Ketu.Locations: Meditation centers, ashrams, isolated places, sacred sites, underground passages.
Ketu.Fundamental: Points toward past karmic inheritance, creates divine discontent and pushes toward enlightenment.
